buildNotes: Reader uses the web target without minification and its pinned PDF.js generic modern-browser build.
Document export uses the pinned PDFAssembler, writeRawAnnotations and FontEmbedder primitives in a worker thread; no rewriting of PDF serialization or annotation encoding.
Optional ONNX models and upstream PDF test corpora are not required by this PDF-only validation path and are excluded from the slim source download.
Application source does not patch upstream source. Platform staging and resource retrieval are kept in scripts/.
Used slim-tree source files are checked against their Git blob hashes; see output/source-download-results.json.
